metadata.source: Chenciner, A. and Montgomery, R. (2000), A remarkable periodic solution of the three-body problem in the case of equal masses, Annals of Mathematics 152, 881-901; initial conditions as computed by C. Simo and quoted there, in units G = m = 1: x1 = -x2 = (0.97000436, -0.24308753), x3 = (0, 0), v3 = (-0.93240737, -0.86473146), v1 = v2 = -v3 / 2 = (0.466203685, 0.43236573), period T = 6.32591398. Scaled here to the AU / Msun / day system: masses 1 Msun, length unit 1 AU, time unit 1 / k = 58.132440867 day (k = 0.01720209895, G = k^2), so positions are unchanged, velocities are multiplied by k and the period is T / k = 367.74082 day
metadata.epoch: arbitrary (t = 0 at the published initial configuration)
metadata.description: Three equal masses (1 Msun) chasing each other on a planar figure-eight; zero total linear and angular momentum. Velocities are 0.466203685 k, 0.43236573 k and -0.93240737 k, -0.86473146 k (AU/day), rounded to double.
